comments.author: imlo2
comments.body:
There's no competition with NanoBanan Pro vs 2.1; it's kind of the same as SeeDream 5.0/5.5 vs SeeDream 5 Lite when it comes to results, a bit more simplistic and not that varying in my experience.

And generally I'd actually recommend SeeDream over NanoBanana Pro, it's more flexible, and if your earlier experiences with 4.5 or earlier versions was kind of a let down, I'd say the photographic style realism and also style and detail consistency has vastly improved, and it's less restrictive, and doesn't try to tone down your ideas like NBP does.

I've generally had really not that great experiences with all of the Flash/Lite/Turbo type of variants or versions.  
  
But the best thing to do is to deposit a bit of money some pay-as-you-go service and produce 50 or so test images as comparison with same prompts. That starts to show it quite quickly what the difference is.
